decisions.reason: Both independent reviews reproduce the same cross-board authority defect: claim/evidence identity can disagree with the lane template that selects the physical probe and target.
decisions.problem_versus_fix: A signed claim could operate a different board, invalidating isolation and provenance. Exact template/fixture correlation before claim and before launch is localized, low-risk, and host-verifiable, so the demonstrated problem materially outweighs the implementation and verification cost.
decisions.smallest_sufficient_route: S2.P validates the selected template against the locked fixture manifest and the closed call before claim acquisition and again before launch, with focused substitution tests.

test_invalidation.reason: The repair changes only firmware acceptance controller/kit behavior and its direct tests; kit.py is an explicit dependency of all three S2 target-materialization IDs, while shared coding-controller dependencies are unchanged.
